slides.texte_overlay:
habits that will make you
unreasonably confident

no filler talking

for one day, cut every "like", "um" and "sorry" you catch yourself saying. a pause in the middle of a sentence sounds like certainty to everyone listening.

solo plans

go to a museum, a cinema or a concert alone once a month. doing what you enjoy without waiting for company is the quietest flex there is.

posture alarms

set three random alarms a day. each time one rings, drop your shoulders and lift your chin. your body learns the shape before your mind believes it.

story collecting

learn the story behind one famous painting or historical figure every day. 5 minutes is enough, and soon you're the person who always has something interesting to say.
slides.texte_sophia:
story collecting

learn the story behind one famous painting or historical figure every day. a micro-learning app like the Sophia app does it in 5 minutes, and soon you're the person who always has something interesting to say.

slides.texte_overlay:
kept compliments

write down every compliment you get in one note. on bad days, read it. your brain remembers criticism for free, it needs help with the rest.
